mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM task WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'SCHEDULING', 'RUNNING', 'STOPPING') AND deleted = false
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET status = #{toStatus}, start_time = CASE WHEN #{toStatus} = 'RUNNING' AND start_time IS NULL THEN now() ELSE start_time END, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE task SET status = 'STOPPING', stopped_by = #{stoppedBy}, stop_reason = #{stopReason}, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND deleted = false
UPDATE task SET priority = 100, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND deleted = false

UPDATE task SET status = 'RUNNING', fail_reason = NULL, finished_steps = #{finishedSteps}, current_step_name = NULL, current_step_index = NULL, start_time = CASE WHEN start_time IS NULL THEN now() ELSE start_time END, end_time = NULL, duration_ms = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus} AND deleted = false
